   36 // ErrRoundLimit when the session has spent its rounds, and the caller                │  const defaultMaxRounds
   37 // decides whether to offer more.                                                     │  var ErrRoundLimit
   38 func (l *Loop) runRound(ctx context.Context) error {                                  │  type Loop
   39     if l.rounds >= l.maxRounds {                                                      │  func New
   40         return ErrRoundLimit                                                          │  func (l *Loop) Run
   41     }                                                                                 │ ▸func (l *Loop) runRound
   42     l.rounds++                                                                        │  func (l *Loop) run
   43     resp, err := l.provider.Send(ctx, l.request())                                    │  func (l *Loop) request
   44     if err != nil {                                                                   │ 
   45         return fmt.Errorf("round %d: %w", l.rounds, err)                              │ a click moves the cursor there
   46     }                                                                                 │

   48         if err := l.run(ctx, call); err != nil {                                      │ 
   49             return err                                                                │ 
   50         }                                                                             │ 
   51     }                                                                                 │ 
   52     return nil                                                                        │
